verdict.rationale: Grafana runs rule-based automations in the background: alert rules are continuously evaluated and send notifications to Slack, PagerDuty and similar tools, on-call escalation routes alerts automatically, and Mimir recording rules generate new data on a schedule. The AI features (Assistant, Investigations) are only named, with no evidence they run autonomously or can be scheduled as background agents. Missing for 10: documented autonomous or scheduled AI agent workflows, background actions beyond notifications and escalation, and independent hands-on corroboration of agentic automation.
